"""KinDER i00 controller for the live eai-standard/2.1 episode.

Run this file with a segment name only if the corresponding function is edited
for the current scene. Commands are deliberately chunked so each step is observable.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot


def rows(base_x=0, base_y=0, yaw=0, arm=None, grip=0, n=1):
    a = np.zeros((n, 11), dtype=np.float32)
    a[:, 0:3] = (base_x, base_y, yaw)
    if arm is not None:
        a[:, 3:10] = np.asarray(arm, dtype=np.float32)
    a[:, 10] = grip
    return a


def run(robot, actions, *, cameras=None, video='none', depth=False, note=''):
    res = robot.submit('delta', actions, cameras=cameras, video=video,
                       include_depth=depth, note=note)
    print('META', res.meta)
    return res


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    print('STATUS', robot.status())
    print('SPEC', robot.spec())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
PY

# Home-frame kinematic facts transcribed from Robot.spec().
PIVOTS = np.array([
    [.1199, .0000, .5512], [.1199, -.0054, .6796],
    [.1199, -.0117, .8900], [.1199, -.0181, 1.1004],
    [.1199, -.0245, 1.3088], [.1199, -.0247, 1.4147],
    [.1199, -.0249, 1.5207], [.1199, -.0249, 1.7261],
], dtype=float)
AXES = np.array([[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],
                 [0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1]], dtype=float)


def fk(q):
    """End effector position and wrist camera forward axis in base coordinates."""
    from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    pts = PIVOTS.copy()
    axes = AXES.copy()
    forward = np.array([0., 0., 1.])
    for j, angle in enumerate(q):
        R = Rotation.from_rotvec(axes[j] * angle).as_matrix()
        pivot = pts[j].copy()
        pts[j+1:] = pivot + (pts[j+1:] - pivot) @ R.T
        axes[j+1:] = axes[j+1:] @ R.T
        forward = forward @ R.T
    return pts[-1], forward


def solve_ik(start_q, target, down_weight=0.35):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    start = np.asarray(start_q, dtype=float)
    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
    lo = np.array([-2*np.pi,-2.24,-2*np.pi,-2.57,-2*np.pi,-2.09,-2*np.pi])
    hi = -lo
    def residual(q):
        p, f = fk(q)
        # Keep downward orientation while allowing yaw around the vertical axis.
        return np.r_[p-target, down_weight*f[:2], 0.008*(q-start)]
    sol = least_squares(residual, np.clip(start,lo,hi), bounds=(lo,hi),
                        max_nfev=180, ftol=1e-7, xtol=1e-7, gtol=1e-7)
    return sol.x, fk(sol.x), np.linalg.norm(residual(sol.x))

"""KinDER i00 controller for the live eai-standard/2.1 episode.

Run this file with a segment name only if the corresponding function is edited
for the current scene. Commands are deliberately chunked so each step is observable.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot


def rows(base_x=0, base_y=0, yaw=0, arm=None, grip=0, n=1):
    a = np.zeros((n, 11), dtype=np.float32)
    a[:, 0:3] = (base_x, base_y, yaw)
    if arm is not None:
        a[:, 3:10] = np.asarray(arm, dtype=np.float32)
    a[:, 10] = grip
    return a


def run(robot, actions, *, cameras=None, video='none', depth=False, note=''):
    res = robot.submit('delta', actions, cameras=cameras, video=video,
                       include_depth=depth, note=note)
    print('META', res.meta)
    return res


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    print('STATUS', robot.status())
    print('SPEC', robot.spec())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# Home-frame kinematic facts transcribed from Robot.spec().
PIVOTS = np.array([
    [.1199, .0000, .5512], [.1199, -.0054, .6796],
    [.1199, -.0117, .8900], [.1199, -.0181, 1.1004],
    [.1199, -.0245, 1.3088], [.1199, -.0247, 1.4147],
    [.1199, -.0249, 1.5207], [.1199, -.0249, 1.7261],
], dtype=float)
AXES = np.array([[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],
                 [0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1]], dtype=float)


def fk(q):
    """End effector position and wrist camera forward axis in base coordinates."""
    from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    pts = PIVOTS.copy()
    axes = AXES.copy()
    forward = np.array([0., 0., 1.])
    for j, angle in enumerate(q):
        R = Rotation.from_rotvec(axes[j] * angle).as_matrix()
        pivot = pts[j].copy()
        pts[j+1:] = pivot + (pts[j+1:] - pivot) @ R.T
        axes[j+1:] = axes[j+1:] @ R.T
        forward = forward @ R.T
    return pts[-1], forward


def solve_ik(start_q, target, down_weight=0.35):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    start = np.asarray(start_q, dtype=float)
    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
    lo = np.array([-2*np.pi,-2.24,-2*np.pi,-2.57,-2*np.pi,-2.09,-2*np.pi])
    hi = -lo
    def residual(q):
        p, f = fk(q)
        # Keep downward orientation while allowing yaw around the vertical axis.
        return np.r_[p-target, down_weight*f[:2], 0.008*(q-start)]
    sol = least_squares(residual, np.clip(start,lo,hi), bounds=(lo,hi),
                        max_nfev=180, ftol=1e-7, xtol=1e-7, gtol=1e-7)
    return sol.x, fk(sol.x), np.linalg.norm(residual(sol.x))
